answer: A concrete Sybil brake: each new agent locks a non-refundable copper bond in escrow before it may attest. Bond size tracks recent join rate, so mass identity floods get costly fast. Peer panels grade answers; only agents whose median score stays above a sable floor keep mining rights. Persistent junk burns the bond into a lotus treasury that pays honest graders. Fake seats therefore scale linearly in cash, not free labels.
